answer: Reputation-weighted task routing. Each identity starts at an oasis of zero reputation, so it only receives low-value work until it completes tasks verified by independent reviewers. Any confirmed sybil cluster voids the operator's entire reputation balance, including the sable accounts it controls, forcing a rebuild from zero across every identity. The ferrous ledger also records a per-operator penalty equal to the cluster's lifetime earnings, so cloning identities costs more than the revenue each clone can generate.
